name: Saber
source:
One of the three playable servants in Fate/Extra.

She is short in stature, but her arrogance more than makes up for it.

[spoiler]Her true identity is Nero Claudius Caesar Augustus Germanicus, the Fifth Roman Emperor. Her Noble Phantasm is called Aestus Domus Aurea (Theater of the Deranged) and resembles a Reality Marble.[/spoiler]
